# ui::SelectionProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The Selection pattern: a container whose entries are SelectionItems (a list, a [Carousel](../controls/carousel.md#uicarousel)). Implement every member.

## selected_items

```cpp
virtual void selected_items(std::vector<Element*>& out) const = 0
```

Appends the selected entries' nodes to `out`. Only entries that exist as nodes can be reported, so a virtualizing list lists the selected entries it has realized.

## can_select_multiple

```cpp
virtual bool can_select_multiple() const = 0
```

Whether more than one entry can be selected at once.

## selection_required

```cpp
virtual bool selection_required() const = 0
```

Whether the control always keeps one entry selected.

## ~SelectionProvider

```cpp
~SelectionProvider() = default
```
